resolution.note: krn standards check passes on KRN: README names npm test, finish-gate enforcement accepts worker-stop wiring, test fixture no longer trips the dist rule

title: KRN passes its own standards pack
body:
Why: `bin/krn standards check --root .` on main dc3acaa prints FAIL 18 enforced, 3 failed: s-readme-test-command, s-clean-checkout-tests, s-finish-gate. The pilot repository fails too (first-harvest lane verdict, logs /mnt/storage/tmp/krn/first-harvest/). A pack its own author fails is either a wrong record or a real gap.
Outcome: for each failing record, either KRN is fixed (README names the test command; tests pass from a clean checkout; finish gate wiring) or the record's enforcement is corrected because it misjudges a valid setup (e.g. KRN's Stop hook may be wired differently than `exec krn hook stop`).
Proof: `bin/krn standards check --root .` prints PASS on main; a regression test at the lowest layer for any enforcement changed; `npm run fast` PASS.
